# Psalm 125 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 125:4 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Do-good O-YHWH to-the-good, and-to-the-upright in-their-hearts.
- **LOGOS:** Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to those who are upright in their hearts!
- **PNEUMA:** LORD, be good to those who are good — to those whose hearts are honest.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 125:1 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** A-song of-the-ascents. Those-trusting in-YHWH like-mount Zion; not it-is-moved, to-forever it-sits.
- **LOGOS:** A Song of Ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion, which cannot be moved, but abides forever.
- **PNEUMA:** A song for the journey to Jerusalem. Those who trust in the LORD are as unshakeable as Mount Zion — it cannot be moved; it stands forever.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 125:3 (overlap: 5%)

- **EMET:** For not will-rest the-scepter-of wickedness on the-lot-of the-righteous, so-that not put-forth the-righteous to-unrighteousness their-hands.
- **LOGOS:** For the scepter of wickedness shall not rest on the land allotted to the righteous, lest the righteous stretch out their hands to do wrong.
- **PNEUMA:** The rule of the wicked will not remain over the land given to the righteous — otherwise even good people might be tempted to do wrong.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 125:2 (overlap: 12%)

- **EMET:** Jerusalem — mountains around-her, and-YHWH around his-people, from-now and-to forever.
- **LOGOS:** As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds his people, from this time forth and forevermore.
- **PNEUMA:** Just as mountains surround Jerusalem, the LORD surrounds his people — now and forever.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

---

## 125:5 (overlap: 15%)

- **EMET:** And-those-turning-aside to-their-crooked-ways, will-lead-them-away YHWH with doers-of iniquity. Peace upon Israel.
- **LOGOS:** But those who turn aside to their crooked ways the LORD will lead away with evildoers! Peace be upon Israel!
- **PNEUMA:** But those who turn to crooked paths — the LORD will march them off with the rest of the evildoers. Peace be with Israel!

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
